summary: A margin of a single vote triggers a mandatory hand recount, and the canvassing board certifies the same winner.
realLife: A county's canvassing board hand-counted a small city's council race decided by one vote, had a second board check the totals against the machine count, and certified the same result with observers present.
sources: Thurston County, Washington, Rainier city council manual recount certified (undated county release): https://www.thurstoncountywa.gov/news/rainier-city-council-race-manual-recount-certified
inGame: needs: a recount threshold in election law and a canvass certification step

turns.turn: The recount matches the first count
turns.writesBack: the winner is certified and the loser concedes

turns.pulledBy: a duplicated batch or a missed ballot
turns.writesBack: a changed total and a second look
